pages.text: Create 6 added a $(thing)logistics$() system: items are packed into $(item)Packages$(), addressed, and delivered between points. It runs on belts, chain conveyors and frogports.

pages.title: Packager
pages.text: Attaches to a chest or machine. With redstone power it packs items; given a package it unpacks into the inventory.

pages.title: Package Frogport
pages.text: Sends and receives packages. Gives each port an address. A chain conveyor links ports together.

pages.title: Chain Conveyor
pages.text: Carries packages and relays rotation like shafts. Frogports attach to it for delivery over long distances.

pages.title: Stock Link
pages.text: Connects packagers to one network. Range is unlimited, but packages still need transport.

pages.title: Stock Ticker
pages.text: Orders items from the whole network. A blaze burner or seated mob in front acts as the Stock Keeper you right-click.

pages.title: Redstone Requester
pages.text: Orders a preset set on each redstone pulse.

pages.title: Factory Gauge
pages.text: Keeps stock at a target amount by requesting ingredients, down to full recipes and crafting setups.

$(thing)Add-ons in this pack$():$(br2)$(li)Factory Logistics: network links, fluid gauges, a Bottler and jars for fluids$(br2)$(li)Mobile Packages: Robo Bee Port to send packages to players, a portable stock ticker
